question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Urge
solution:
The correct answer is '**Appeal**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Urge**' is '**Appeal**'.
 
• **Urge**: to advise or try hard to persuade somebody to do something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति को कुछ करने के लिए समझाना या प्रबल रूप से प्रेरित करना)
 
 
• *Example: I **urged** him to fight the decision.*
 
 
 
• **Appeal**: to make a serious request for something you need or want very much. (औपचारिक रूप से अनुरोध करना; निवेदन या याचना करना)
 
 
• *Example: Relief workers in the disaster area are **appealing** for more supplies.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Appeal.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of other **words:**

 
 
• **Reply**: to say, write or do something as an answer to somebody/something. (जवाब या उत्तर के रूप में किसी को कुछ कहना, लिखना या कुछ करना)
 
• **Refuse**: to say or show that you do not want to do, give, or accept something. [(किसी बात को मानने, काम को करने से) इनकार करना या बात नामंज़ूर होना]
 
• **Protest**: a statement or action that shows that you do not like or approve of something. (किसी बात की नापसंदगी या अस्‍वीकृति दिखाने वाला वक्तव्‍य या कार्य; विरोध)
